summary: Implemented provider-independent phone OTP authentication for Seekers and Property Providers. Added strict E.164 normalization and role/purpose DTOs; POST /api/v1/auth/otp/send and /verify; deterministic Local/Test delivery with fail-closed unconfigured non-local environments; domain-separated keyed OTP hashes; five-minute TTL, five attempts, 60-second per-target resend cooldown, public UUID challenges, atomic replay/concurrency guards, delivery-failure invalidation, and explicit active/query/grant/TTL indexes. Existing-account verification uses the shared access-token and rotating opaque-refresh session issuer. Registration verification returns a ten-minute opaque authority whose hash can be atomically redeemed once by the next registration task without creating an account here. OTP provider readiness now participates in /ready while /health remains process liveness. Runtime inventory, OpenAPI, Postman, product blueprint, tests, and documentation are synchronized at seven implemented routes.
